description: This file defines cryptographic function prototypes and constants for platform-specific crypto operations, such as generating random bytes, Diffie-Hellman key pairs, computing SHA256 and HMAC, and AES encryption/decryption, used in the IEEE 1905.1/1a stack implementation.

methods.name: PLATFORM_GET_RANDOM_BYTES
methods.description: Fills a buffer with random bytes, used for cryptographic operations such as key generation.

methods.name: PLATFORM_GENERATE_DH_KEY_PAIR
methods.description: Generates a Diffie-Hellman key pair for secure key exchange.

methods.name: PLATFORM_COMPUTE_DH_SHARED_SECRET
methods.description: Computes the shared secret from the peer’s public key and local private key.

methods.name: PLATFORM_SHA256
methods.description: Computes SHA256 digest of concatenated inputs.

methods.name: PLATFORM_HMAC_SHA256
methods.description: Computes HMAC using SHA256 with a given key.

methods.name: PLATFORM_AES_ENCRYPT
methods.description: Encrypts data using AES-128 in CBC mode.

methods.name: PLATFORM_AES_DECRYPT
methods.description: Decrypts data encrypted with AES-128 in CBC mode.
